summary: 18-year-old man hurt his leg in a snowmobile accident near Idleglen; later reported to have no significant injuries.
notes: Post dated 2020-03-22 15:20 MDT describes 'yesterday' missions (2020-03-21). One of two snowmobile accidents near Idleglen in the same response; later reported to have no significant injuries. Distinct from the same-day 50-year-old woman's broken leg.
